headline: Khaitan & Co advises Persistent Systems on ₹7,600 crore acquisition financing
sum: Khaitan & Co acted as legal advisors to Persistent Systems Limited on its acquisition financing and general corporate purposes funding for the proposed acquisition of Nagarro SE, a German-listed digital engineering company. The financing…
detail: Khaitan & Co acted as legal advisors to Persistent Systems Limited on its acquisition financing and general corporate purposes funding for the proposed acquisition of Nagarro SE, a German-listed digital engineering company. The financing package comprised: (i) Persistent's maiden issuance of listed, rated, unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures aggregating to ₹7,000 crore across six series; and (ii) an issuance of listed commercial papers aggregating ₹600 crore. The Khaitan & Co transaction team comprised Manisha Shroff (Partner), Rajshekhar Upadhyaya (Principal Associate), Akshansh Sharma (Senior Associate), Aastha Singh (Senior Associate), Khushboo Damakia (Senior Associate),…
